recipes.label: Light
recipes.startdescription:
A light that wells up from the depths of my mind — I can use it to scout for opportunities in a location, or to reveal someone who is hiding.

[This card can be used for rapid reconnaissance or to expose a hidden enemy.]

recipes.label: Reveal the Enemy's Location
recipes.startdescription:
They lurk in the shadows, and I shall force them into the light.

[Use an Ability card that meets the requirements to reveal a hidden enemy.]
recipes.description: The shadows are shattered — there will be no more mercy.

recipes.label: Defeat the Demigod Huntress?
recipes.startdescription:
There is no denying that Skadi is an extraordinarily dangerous and powerful foe. Yet after several exchanges, I have come to understand her mind and her abilities all the more; and where understanding is sufficient, there is no enemy that cannot be defeated—

[This will consume all of your Insights, and grant you a way to defeat the Huntress.]
recipes.description: Perhaps, with careful planning and design, I might lure her onto an open battlefield, overcome her in a true confrontation, and wash away my shame completely.

recipes.label: Seek the Road to the Orchard
recipes.startdescription:
Following the direction Celia has shown, I will seek the road from the Bounds to the Orchard of Lights—

[This will grant you access to the Orchard of Lights, but you may do so only once. Before you set out, make certain you possess the will for an ending, to face the trial of the Sun-in-Rags.]
recipes.description: An audience with a god is unquestionably perilous; an audience with a god who favors endings is perilous to the point of madness. I hope I am prepared.
